title: Billing the CondoGuard Liability Step Charge for the Rest of the Term
content:
Billing office rule of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy: the share of the full-year liability step charge billed for the rest of the term depends on how the term is billed.

1. On a two-pay or quarterly plan with at least one installment of the current term not yet billed, the liability share is the number of the current term's installments not yet billed divided by the plan's number of installments (2 for two-pay, 4 for quarterly), where the installments billed are the premium installments posted with the current term's effective date.
2. On a monthly EFT plan (12 installments a term) with at least one installment of the current term not yet billed, the liability share is the whole calendar months from the day the raise takes effect to the expiration date, a part month dropped, divided by 12.
3. On any other plan, or when every installment of the current term has already been billed, the liability share is the calendar days from the day the raise takes effect to the expiration date divided by the calendar days in the term.

| Plan | Installments of the current term not yet billed | Liability share |
|---|---|---|
| two-pay | 1 or 2 | unbilled installments divided by 2 |
| quarterly | 1 to 4 | unbilled installments divided by 4 |
| monthly EFT | 1 to 12 | whole calendar months to the expiration date, part month dropped, divided by 12 |
| two-pay, quarterly or monthly EFT | none | calendar days to the expiration date divided by the calendar days in the term |
| annual or mortgagee escrow | any | calendar days to the expiration date divided by the calendar days in the term |

## Cases (hypothetical policies)

- Quarterly plan, installments 1 and 2 of the current term posted: 2 not yet billed, share 2 divided by 4, one half.
- Two-pay plan, both installments of the current term posted: every installment billed, so the day share applies.
- Monthly EFT plan with 5 installments posted, raise taking effect on 15 March, expiration date 1 November: whole months from 15 March to 1 November are 7 (to 15 October), the part month to 1 November is dropped, share 7 divided by 12.
- Annual plan, 200 days left in a 365-day term: share 200 divided by 365.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A full-year liability step charge of 14.00 USD on a quarterly plan with 2 installments unbilled: 14.00 multiplied by one half is 7.00 USD for the rest of the term.
